interpretation.dump_mismatch: oredict live ≠ config live → unexpected post-config mutation or dump bug
interpretation.missing_config: expected apply target but no cfg prop (should be rare for valid materials/prefixes)
interpretation.orphan_config: cfg prop with no matching dump subject
interpretation.overridden: config live ≠ default embedded in key → player/pack changed this value
interpretation.skipped_invalid: INVALID_MATERIAL / PREFIX_UNUSED — GT skips apply; dump may still show source fields
interpretation.source_fixed: meltingPoint, components, tags, amount, texture sets, etc. are NOT config-overridable
interpretation.tunable_unchanged: mapped and equal → adjustable but currently at source default
